description: This file defines a custom matcher function 'toMatchAriaSnapshot' for use in testing frameworks, specifically for matching ARIA snapshots in Playwright tests. It includes logic for reading, comparing, and optionally generating snapshot files, with support for snapshot updates and error handling.

methods.name: toMatchAriaSnapshot
methods.description: Asynchronous function that compares a locator's ARIA snapshot against a stored snapshot, with support for updating or generating new snapshots based on test configuration.

methods.name: unshift
methods.description: Helper function that removes common leading whitespace from each line in a snapshot string.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Helper function that indents each line of a snapshot string with a specified string.
